title: Practice 6: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: I'll drive Tom home.
exercises.why: **довезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of довезти: perfective (imperfective partner: довозить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: He passed among the crowd.
exercises.why: **прошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: The dog runs out of the house.
exercises.why: **выбегает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выбегать: imperfective (perfective partner: выбежать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I've come to pick up Tom.
exercises.why: **пришёл** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Did your trip go well?
exercises.why: **прошла** — past tense (feminine) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: I've come to see you.
exercises.why: **пришёл** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Is it included in the price?
exercises.why: **входит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: I'll take you to school.
exercises.why: **отведу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom is finally back.
exercises.why: **пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I was scolded by my teacher.
exercises.why: **влетело** — past tense (neuter) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom brought me home.
exercises.why: **привёз** — past tense (masculine) of привезти: perfective (imperfective partner: привозить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: He was taken to the hospital.
exercises.why: **увезли** — past tense (plural) of увезти: perfective (imperfective partner: увозить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The small dog crossed the road.
exercises.why: **перешла** — past tense (feminine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Let's stop by the post office.
exercises.why: **зайдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The boat was carried away with the current.
exercises.why: **снесло** — past tense (neuter) of снести: perfective (imperfective partner: сносить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: That plane will take off at five.
exercises.why: **вылетит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of вылететь: perfective (imperfective partner: вылетать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: A murmur passed through the crowd.
exercises.why: **пробежал** — past tense (masculine) of пробежать: perfective (imperfective partner: пробегать).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: We came to the pier.
exercises.why: **пришли** — past tense (plural) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The plane is just about to start.
exercises.why: **взлетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of взлетать: imperfective (perfective partner: взлететь).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The post is delivered in the morning.
exercises.why: **разносят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of разносить: imperfective (perfective partner: разнести).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).
